title: ISO 4407:2025 — Hydraulic fluid power — Fluid contamination — Determination of particulate contamination by the counting method using an optical microscope
locator: Abstract and lifecycle: membrane-filter microscopy particle-counting methods, including manual or image-analysis-assisted methods; published 2025-12 and replaces ISO 4407:2002.
notes: Method standard for particle determination in fluids that can be vacuum-filtered through an appropriate membrane. It does not set a machine-tool hydraulic cleanliness target or validate coolant filtration system performance by itself.
